sloka: धन्विनौ तौ सुखम् गत्वा लम्बमाने दिवा करे ।गन्गा यमुनयोह् सम्धौ प्रापतुर् निलयम् मुनेः ॥२-५४-८॥
transliteration: dhanvinau tau sukham gatvā lambamāne divā kare ।gangā yamunayoh samdhau prāpatur nilayam muneḥ ॥2-54-8॥

translations.english: The two archers (Rama and Lakshmana) reached comfortably (walking at an easy pace) by evening the hermitage of sage Bharadwaja near the confluence of Ganga and Yamuna.
